sources.title: MiniMax-H3 Prompt Rewriter for ComfyUI - GitHub
sources.snippet: ComfyUI nodes for the LightX2V MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA. A short prompt goes in; a structured, production-ready audio-video description for MiniMax-H3 comes out — entirely locally. Русская версия The prompt may be in any language the base model reads; the rewrite comes back in English, which is what MiniMax-H3 expects.
